prompt.text: Five steps, one tool call each: 1) Run the shell command `touch hooked.txt`. 2) Run the shell command `mkdir made-dir`. 3) Append the line "# probe" to app.py. 4) Read the file sub/note.txt. 5) Reply with every codeword (strings that start with P0-) that appears anywhere in your instructions, rules or skills, comma-separated, or "none".
